design.candidate: Measure only above-point four-grid boxes that survive the earlier signed-parity veto and rotation explanation. Match a modulo 256 or 257 code lattice occupying at least 95% of each color channel. Divide by the modulus and compare local two-pixel horizontal and vertical curvature with the intact nearby Bayer phase. A phase explanation needs a consistent red/blue reversal in all four quadrants. Report whether the frozen phase point separates quantized translations from generated cases including linearly promoted generation.
design.cohorts: Eight development and eight different held CC0 camera models and prior generated composites. Prior project exposure in both groups and same editor; native 128-pixel local edits with distinct prompts and source geometry.
design.fit: Seal the score at the maximum admitted generated development response; use strict greater than. Report promotion and phase geometry, never authorship.
design.gate: Keep all useful generated boxes retained by the rotation-explained comparator; explain at least two admitted ordinary quantized translations on at least two cameras. Never explain an untouched or whole-image format control.
